title: eludite.editor.replace input
description: Quick Replace (Ctrl+H): replace the next match (Replace Next, from the primary selection) or every match (Replace All, one undo step). Without query, open the Quick Replace bar.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.

query.description: Text, or a regular expression with regex.

replacement.description: The replacement; with regex, $1, ${1}, ${name} and $$ expand.

all.description: Replace All instead of Replace Next.
